owner_instruction: Если в AVMA проект закрыт, значит закрыт. Если стоят даты окончания исследования, и набор пока идёт, считаем эту дату концом набора.

avma_closed.scope: Exact same protocol/cohort only; current AVMA Completed/Closed/Terminated/Withdrawn is sufficient to end matching even when the institution page survives.

study_end_as_recruitment_end.scope: Published patient study/research-period end for the same currently recruiting protocol/cohort/site is the recruitment cutoff unless a more specific enrollment cutoff is published.

clinical_dates: Policy application is not a new full clinical review or funding verification. Preserve all original evidence dates.
